capability: See how your notes connect, as one map
title: Pull every thread into view.

hook.picture: Close on the whale digging through a tall stack of note cards, flipping one at a time. The card it needs is three down, unseen.
hook.words: I know I wrote this somewhere.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: I have years of notes and can't see how they connect.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: cards in folders. Three times a card in one folder points to a card in another, and the thread is cut at the folder wall.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Folders hide the links between ideas.

stakes.body: You repeat old work, and miss the idea that ties a talk together.

solution_hint: Draw the links, not just the notes.

metaphor.body: The cards lift out of their folders and become points on a sphere, with threads between linked cards. Groups gather, and the card many threads pass through swells.

steps.picture: Cards lift out of the folders and become points on a sphere, spaced in a sunflower spiral. Threads draw between linked cards.
steps.sound: Notes bloom one by one, in tune.

steps.picture: Points that link a lot drift together into four coloured groups.
Push-in on one small card that many threads run through. It swells: the bridge the whale forgot.
steps.words: The bridge note grows. Now you see it.
steps.sound: A low note under all four groups.

steps.picture: The whole sphere folds into one small file card, and the whale tucks it under its fin.

real_case.claim: KOCHI turns a markdown or Obsidian vault into a 3D graph with Louvain clusters and centrality sizing, built as a single offline HTML file of about 400KB; the vault stays local.

honest_limit.picture: Two notes that contradict each other sit in the same group, joined by a thread. The map shows that they link, not that they agree.
honest_limit.words: Linked is not the same as agreeing.

not_this.body: The map shows links, not who's right.

ending_pattern.body: The pod asks the same question as in FELT. This time the whale spins the sphere, finds the swollen bridge card at once, and the pod answers ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: Same pod, same question as bar 2, and the right card arrives before the meeting.

end_belief.body: Look at the links between your notes.

beats.picture: Close: the whale flips cards off a tall stack, one by one.
beats.words: I know I wrote this somewhere.
beats.sound: Paper flicks, one muted note each.

beats.picture: A pod asks a question. The whale hands it the wrong card, and the pod answers with a copper ✕ chip.
beats.words: I found it after the meeting.

beats.picture: The right card slides out of the stack as the pod leaves.
The whale looks at the card, too late. Hold.
beats.camera: Close z 1.7, hold on the whale's face

beats.picture: Half a bar of stillness, then the title.
beats.camera: Still z 1.6, half bar of stillness

beats.picture: Pull back: rows of folders. A thread from one card stops dead at its folder wall.
beats.words: Folders hide the links between ideas.
beats.sound: Problem motif: a note that cuts off.

beats.picture: Two more threads cut at folder walls, every 1 beat then half.
Motion stops. Faint threads ghost through the folder walls.
beats.words: Draw the links, not just the notes.
beats.sound: One sustained, clean note: the signature.

beats.picture: Cards lift out of the folders and become points on a sphere, spaced in a sunflower spiral. Threads draw between linked cards.
beats.sound: Notes bloom one by one, in tune.

beats.picture: Points that link a lot drift together into four coloured groups.
Push-in on one small card that many threads run through. It swells: the bridge the whale forgot.
beats.words: The bridge note grows. Now you see it.
beats.sound: A low note under all four groups.

beats.picture: The whole sphere folds into one small file card, and the whale tucks it under its fin.
Wide: a pile of plain note cards flows in and comes out as one small file card holding the sphere.
beats.words: Real notes in, one file out.

beats.picture: The file card stays inside a circle around the whale. No line leaves the circle.
beats.words: Your notes stay on your machine.

beats.picture: Two cards that say opposite things sit in the same coloured group. The thread between them glows teal as if they agree.
beats.words: Linked is not the same as agreeing.

beats.picture: Slow push to the two clashing cards.
beats.camera: One slow push to the thing that slipped

beats.picture: FELT framing: the pod asks again. The whale spins the sphere, the bridge card lights, and the whale hands it over.
beats.camera: Close z 1.6, the FELT framing restored

beats.picture: The pod answers ✓. The sphere hangs over the line.
The sphere slowly turning, the whale breathing.
beats.words: Look at the links between your notes.

beats.picture: SERIES.lockup.

captions.text: I know I wrote this somewhere.
I found it after the meeting.
Folders hide the links between ideas.

Real notes in, one file out.
Your notes stay on your machine.
Linked is not the same as agreeing.

sound.signature: A sustained clean note per linked card, blooming into chords.
sound.problem_motif: A note that cuts off mid-sustain.

score_self.reason: Everyone has this pain, and the sphere-of-points picture is very visual. The case card is a spec rather than a run, which is honest but weak. The limit is pictured well.
